scientific_integrity: The result is supported by a self-contained directed-matrix-tree/BEST proof and a stand-alone exact verifier of 212 balanced three-edge deletion sets. Self-review was completed, but no independent scientific audit, peer review, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is for \(q\ge3\) and \(n\ge2\) and three missing cyclic n-windows. It counts labeled-alphabet necklaces modulo rotation, not multiplicity-balanced P-sequences; it excludes binary alphabets and other defects. Numerical certificates are finite supplements to a symbolic proof. Some unindexed literature may contain an equivalent characterization.
title: Three-window-defect enumeration for nonbinary generalized de Bruijn necklaces
